prose: A post argues AI that can decompile games and software means anyone can reuse any program, so companies can steal from competitors and paid apps can be open-sourced against the owner's will, while it is also a big win for preservation since old games can be ported and enhanced. It follows an indie developer using AI to decompile a game. Basis: the excerpt.
highlights: AI decompilation works on any software, not just old games.
Risks: copying competitors, open-sourcing paid software.
Benefit: preservation and porting of old games.
